<documents>
<document id="account-documents">
DocumentsˆforˆidentityˆverificationˆToˆverifyˆyourˆidentity,ˆweˆneedˆaˆphotoˆIDˆandˆaˆselfie,ˆplusˆaˆfewˆdetails.ˆ##ˆPhotoˆIDsˆweˆacceptˆ-ˆUSˆdriver'sˆlicenseˆorˆstateˆIDˆcardˆ-ˆUSˆpassportˆorˆpassportˆcardˆ-ˆPermanentˆresidentˆcardˆ-ˆForeignˆpassport,ˆtogetherˆwithˆanˆITINˆTheˆIDˆmustˆbeˆunexpired,ˆandˆallˆfourˆcornersˆmustˆbeˆvisibleˆinˆtheˆphoto.ˆ##ˆSelfieˆTheˆappˆasksˆyouˆtoˆtakeˆaˆshortˆselfieˆvideoˆtoˆmatchˆyourˆfaceˆtoˆtheˆID.ˆRemoveˆglassesˆandˆhats,ˆandˆuseˆgoodˆlight.ˆ##ˆDetailsˆYourˆlegalˆname,ˆdateˆofˆbirth,ˆresidentialˆaddressˆandˆSocialˆSecurityˆnumberˆorˆITIN.ˆYourˆnameˆmustˆmatchˆyourˆID.ˆ##ˆProofˆofˆaddressˆIfˆweˆcan'tˆconfirmˆyourˆaddressˆautomatically,ˆwe'llˆaskˆforˆaˆdocumentˆdatedˆwithinˆtheˆlastˆ90ˆdays,ˆsuchˆasˆaˆutilityˆbill,ˆleaseˆorˆbankˆstatement.ˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆdon'tˆacceptˆExpiredˆIDs,ˆphotocopies,ˆstudentˆIDs,ˆorˆscreenshotsˆofˆanˆID.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="docs-account-details">
FindingˆyourˆaccountˆandˆroutingˆnumbersˆYourˆroutingˆnumberˆandˆaccountˆnumberˆareˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆAccountˆdetails.ˆYou'llˆneedˆthemˆforˆdirectˆdeposit,ˆtoˆlinkˆTallowbrookˆatˆanotherˆbank,ˆorˆtoˆreceiveˆaˆwire.ˆ##ˆWhereˆtoˆfindˆthemˆTapˆProfile,ˆthenˆAccountˆdetails.ˆTapˆtheˆeyeˆiconˆtoˆshowˆtheˆfullˆaccountˆnumber.ˆTheˆappˆasksˆyouˆtoˆconfirmˆit'sˆyouˆfirst.ˆ##ˆCardˆnumberˆversusˆaccountˆnumberˆYourˆcardˆnumberˆisˆdifferentˆfromˆyourˆaccountˆnumber.ˆDon'tˆgiveˆyourˆcardˆnumberˆtoˆanˆemployerˆforˆdirectˆdeposit.ˆ##ˆKeepingˆthemˆsafeˆOnlyˆgiveˆyourˆaccountˆandˆroutingˆnumbersˆtoˆpeopleˆandˆcompaniesˆyouˆtrust,ˆsuchˆasˆyourˆemployer.ˆSomeoneˆwithˆtheseˆnumbersˆcanˆtryˆtoˆpullˆmoneyˆbyˆACH.ˆIfˆthatˆhappens,ˆyouˆcanˆdisputeˆit.ˆ##ˆSupportˆwon'tˆreadˆthemˆoutˆForˆsecurity,ˆsupportˆwon'tˆreadˆyourˆfullˆaccountˆnumberˆorˆcardˆnumberˆtoˆyouˆinˆchatˆorˆonˆtheˆphone.ˆYouˆcanˆalwaysˆseeˆthemˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆ##ˆWireˆinstructionsˆForˆincomingˆwires,ˆuseˆtheˆWireˆinstructionsˆscreenˆunderˆAccountˆdetails,ˆwhichˆalsoˆshowsˆourˆSWIFTˆcodeˆforˆinternationalˆwires.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="wires-incoming">
ReceivingˆaˆwireˆYouˆcanˆreceiveˆdomesticˆandˆinternationalˆwiresˆintoˆyourˆTallowbrookˆaccountˆonˆanyˆplan.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆgiveˆtheˆsenderˆYourˆroutingˆnumber,ˆaccountˆnumber,ˆfullˆlegalˆnameˆandˆaddressˆareˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆAccountˆdetails,ˆthenˆWireˆinstructions.ˆInternationalˆsendersˆalsoˆneedˆourˆSWIFTˆcode,ˆshownˆonˆtheˆsameˆscreen.ˆ##ˆFeesˆ|ˆPlanˆ|ˆIncomingˆdomesticˆwireˆ|ˆIncomingˆinternationalˆwireˆ|ˆ|---|---|---|ˆ|ˆBasicˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆ$10.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆPlusˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆ$10.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆPremiumˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆ##ˆTimingˆDomesticˆwiresˆusuallyˆarriveˆwithinˆhoursˆonˆaˆbusinessˆday.ˆInternationalˆwiresˆcanˆtakeˆlonger,ˆdependingˆonˆtheˆsendingˆbank.ˆ##ˆIfˆaˆwireˆhasn'tˆarrivedˆAskˆtheˆsenderˆforˆtheˆwireˆreferenceˆnumberˆandˆtheˆdateˆitˆwasˆsent,ˆthenˆmessageˆsupport.ˆWiresˆwithˆaˆnameˆthatˆdoesn'tˆmatchˆyourˆaccountˆnameˆmayˆbeˆreturnedˆtoˆtheˆsender.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>

response.text: {"answer":"For identity verification, provide an unexpired accepted photo ID, a selfie video, and your legal name, date of birth, residential address, and SSN or ITIN. If asked for proof of address, submit a document dated within the last 90 days, such as a utility bill, lease, or bank statement. Photocopies, expired IDs, student IDs, and ID screenshots aren’t accepted. For help, contact support in the app at any hour.\n\nTo find your account and routing numbers, open Profile → Account details and tap the eye icon after confirming it’s you. Your card number is different; don’t use it for direct deposit. Only share account and routing numbers with trusted people or companies. Support won’t read full account or card numbers to you. For incoming wires, open Account details → Wire instructions. Domestic and international wires are supported on every plan. Incoming domestic wires are free; incoming international wires cost $10 on Basic and Plus, and are free on Premium. Domestic wires usually arrive within hours on a business day; international wires may take longer. If a wire hasn’t arrived, ask the sender for its reference number and send date, then contact support. Wires with a name that doesn’t match your account name may be returned. Contact support in the app at any hour.","citations":["account-documents","docs-account-details","wires-incoming"],"escalate":false}
